LAHORE, Jul 15 (APP): The Water and Power Development Authority (WAPDA) on Monday released the data of water in rivers and reservoirs. Indus at Tarbela: Inflows 312,400 cusecs and Outflows 275,000 cusecs; Kabul at Nowshera: Inflows 61,900 cusecs and Outflows 61,900 cusecs; Jhelum at Mangla: Inflows 72,300 cusecs and Outflows 40,000 cusecs; Chenab at Marala: Inflows 88,100 cusecs and Outflows 61,500 cusecs. Tarbela: Minimum Operating Level 1402.00 feet, Present Level 1512.64 feet, Maximum Conservation Level 1550.00 feet, Live Storage 4.118 MAF; Mangla: Minimum Operating Level 1050.00 feet, Present Level 1201.35 feet, Maximum Conservation Level 1242.00 feet, Live Storage 3.871 MAF; Chashma: Minimum Operating Level 638.15 feet, Present Level 645.10 feet, Maximum Conservation Level 649.00 feet, Live Storage 0.150 MAF.
